The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. Laptops must be provided with the carry bags. No extra payment shall be entertained.

6. The offered product and the model must be available on the official website of OEM. 7. OEM must have 15 years of existence in India in Laptop manufacturing. 8.
